title: R8 v15-r1 Runtime Authority Contracts
description: Structural contracts derived only from the frozen normalized R8 v15-r1 design. Cross-field authority semantics remain owned by the SchemaFreezeValidator.

x-validator-invariants: authority-bearing identifiers must resolve as exact stable canonical IDs under the owning registry or source contract; aliases/display names are invalid where stable-ID authority is required
lexical syntax remains opaque unless the frozen source contract explicitly defines it
digest lexical form and algorithm must satisfy the exact governing source rule or current bound crypto profile; generic Digest is opaque and does not imply a global SHA-256 encoding
where a frozen source rule explicitly fixes SHA-256 or another concrete encoding, the validator must reject values that do not satisfy that exact encoding before authority use
successor generation exactly predecessor+1
4-of-5 active EBA across at least 3 active admin domains
new/reactivated admin domain cannot sign manifest that creates/reactivates it
exact challenge/context match
live challenge accepted once
max authority-bearing response age 30 verifier-monotonic seconds
all high-water values meet challenge minima
tree size cannot decrease
same tree size with different root is BTW_EQUIVOCATION
append-only history
UNREVOKE does not erase prior revoked interval
semantic_state_sequence is current LAS committed index fixing all named heads
state_root_digest equals GCP-1 digest of exact frozen members
historical/caller-selected sequence has authority NONE
specificity_score equals exact non-ANY component count
ANY components validated at AIM_Smax against current AIMScopePolicy
source-lineage/policy/class/scope change requires linked successor under constitutional path
only current PASS evidence for the exact authorized tuple can qualify resolver
cached/stale prior PASS cannot substitute during outage
specificity_score equals exact non-ANY component count
semantic_entry_key equals canonical digest of semantic_input_id+semantic_lineage_id+semantic_version+scope_tuple
ANY use requires current matching ANYScopePermission
reviewer must be independent from proposer under canonical identity/domain rules
rewrapping/copying cannot upgrade evidence class
producer revocation evaluated temporally
mandatory missing/contradictory evidence blocks promotion
UNATTESTED_RUNTIME has authority effect NONE and cannot act as root/terminal authority evaluator or strong evidence producer
arrays use frozen canonical ordering
updates are LAS-governed authority events
all resolution-time records come from one coherent current semantic snapshot
only ACTIVE permission at decision sequence is valid
every ANY position used by a SemanticEntry must be explicitly listed
project/org/experiment policy cannot create or broaden constitutional permission
class_rules semantic_class values unique
project/org/experiment policy cannot broaden AIMScopePolicy

ScopeReplacementOutsideTableInput.description: Outside-table scope-replacement input. Any non-REVOKED source entry state must return NOT_A_REPLACEMENT_BRANCH before SRTT-4 table lookup.
